# Προαπαιτούμενα



```{r}
rm(list = ls())
if(!require(tidyverse)){
  install.packages("tidyverse")
  library(tidyverse)
}
```


```{r}
mpg
```

# Γράφημα διασποράς

## Απλό 

```{r}
ggplot(data=mpg)+geom_point(mapping=aes(x=displ, y=hwy))
```

## Αισθητικές παρεμβάσεις

```{r}
ggplot(data=mpg)+geom_point(mapping = aes(x=displ, y=hwy, color=class))
```


```{r}
ggplot(data = mpg)+geom_point(mapping = aes(x=displ, y=hwy, size = cyl))
```


```{r}
ggplot(data = mpg) + geom_point(mapping = aes(x=displ, y=hwy, shape = class))
```

## Όψεις

```{r}
ggplot(data = mpg) + geom_point(mapping = aes(x=displ, y=hwy))+facet_wrap(~ class, nrow=2)
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = mpg) + geom_point(mapping = aes(x=displ, y=hwy)) + facet_grid(drv~cyl)
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = mpg) + geom_point(mapping = aes(x=displ, y = hwy)) + facet_grid(drv ~.)
```


```{r}
ggplot(data = mpg) + geom_point(mapping = aes(x=displ, y=hwy)) + facet_grid(.~ cyl)
```

# Καμπύλη παλινδρόμησης

## Μεμονομένη

```{r}
ggplot(data = mpg) + geom_smooth(mapping = aes(x=displ, y = hwy))
```

## Με συνδυασμούς

```{r}
ggplot(data = mpg) + geom_smooth(mapping = aes(x= displ, y=hwy, linetype = drv, color = drv)) +geom_point(mapping = aes(x= displ, y= hwy, color = drv))
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = mpg, mapping = aes(x=displ, y=hwy)) + geom_point(aes(color=class)) + geom_smooth(aes(linetype = drv)) 
```

## Φιλτράρισμα

```{r}
ggplot(data = mpg, mapping = aes(x=displ, y=hwy)) + geom_point(aes(colour = class)) + geom_smooth(data = filter(mpg, class=="subcompact"), se = F)
```

# Ραβδόγραμμα

## Απόλυτων συχνοτήτων

```{r}
diamonds
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = diamonds) + geom_bar(mapping = aes(x=cut))
```

```{r}
demo = tribble(
  ~a, ~b,
  "bar1", 20,
  "bar2", 30,
  "bar3", 40
)
demo
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = demo) + geom_bar(mapping = aes(x=a, y=b), stat = "identity")
```

## Σχετικών συχνοτήτων

```{r}
ggplot(data = diamonds) + geom_bar(mapping = aes(x = cut, y = ..prop.., group = 0))
```

## Χρωματισμοί

```{r}
ggplot(data = diamonds) + geom_bar(mapping = aes(x=cut, color=cut))
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = diamonds) + geom_bar(mapping = aes(x = cut, fill= cut))
```

## Απεικόνιση ομάδων

```{r}
ggplot(data = diamonds) + geom_bar(mapping = aes(x=cut, fill = clarity))
```


```{r}
ggplot(data = diamonds, mapping = aes(x=cut, fill = clarity)) + geom_bar(alpha = 1/5, position = "identity")
```


```{r}
ggplot(data = diamonds, mapping = aes(x = cut, color=clarity)) + geom_bar(fill=NA, position = "identity")
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = diamonds, mapping = aes(x=cut, fill = clarity)) + geom_bar(position = "fill")
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = diamonds) + geom_bar(mapping = aes(x=cut, fill = clarity), position = "dodge")
```

# Jitter

```{r}
ggplot(data = mpg) + geom_point(mapping = aes(x=displ, y=hwy), position = "jitter")
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = mpg) + geom_jitter(mapping = aes(x=displ, y=hwy))
```

# Θηκόγραμμα

## Απλό

```{r}
ggplot(data = mpg) + geom_boxplot(mapping = aes(x=class, y=hwy))
```

## Αντιστροφή συντεταγμένων


```{r}
ggplot(data = mpg) + geom_boxplot(mapping = aes(x=class, y=hwy)) +coord_flip()
```

## Με jitter

```{r}
ggplot(data = mpg, mapping = aes(x=class, y=hwy)) + geom_boxplot(outliers=F) + geom_jitter()
```


# Πολικές συσντεταγμένες


```{r}
ggplot(data = diamonds, mapping = aes(x=cut, fill=cut)) + geom_bar() + coord_polar()
```
